finding: Taiwan TPEx provides the required source families for company-bond trades/quotes, rates, fair values and corporate-bond curves, but a clean multi-date issuer-security historical replay was not independently extracted in this round. The dynamic historical route was unavailable and historical bulk data access is a separate acquisition path. No synthetic yield/spread history was fabricated.

sourceRoute.semantics: Trade, quote, reference and fair-value observations remain distinct provenance classes.

blockers: No validated cross-issuer/multi-date security-level transaction replay in this round.
A model/reference fair value is not an actual trade.
No-trade/stale observations cannot be silently forward-filled.
Duration/currency mismatch blocks clean spread construction.

decision.reason: L3 requires Taiwan PIT replay at issuer-security-date level, not merely a known data-source route.

next: Acquire or query historical TPEx security-level observations with date/security/provenance labels.
Validate at least multiple issuers and dates with maturity/currency-matched sovereign benchmarks.
Only then promote D22-04/D22-06 to L3.
